daily.title: Russia detains Japanese journalist on suspicion of spying

daily.title: Japanese municipalities with over 5% foreign nationals up more than twofold

daily.title: Komeito’s new chief eyes political realignment

daily.title: Lawmakers split on including nuclear submarine study in security documents

daily.title: BOJ is said to lean against back-to-back rate hike in October
daily.summary: The BOJ officials see little need for consecutive rate hikes in the absence of signs that upside inflation risks will increase abruptly.

daily.title: Japan and U.S. review troops’ off-duty rules after Okinawa killing

daily.title: Japan’s 2026 rice harvest projected to fall 1%

daily.title: NASA’s Perseverance rover breaks record for off-planet driving on Mars

daily.title: IMF raises Japan’s growth forecast for 2026 to 0.7%

daily.title: Swiatek aiming to end year on a positive note as WTA Finals spot hangs in balance

daily.title: It’s time for Thailand to amend its controversial lese-majeste law

daily.summary: Athletes have previously spoken cautiously about the exemptions, long a sensitive subject in a country where most young men are required to serve.
